The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 11011 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 1 July - the folder's feast day. Captioned Kosma and Damian and filed under Category:Icons of Cosmas and Damian; 1 July is the Roman pair of unmercenaries, commemorated jointly, so the joint plate is this folder's own hero. The Asian pair keeps 1 November and has its own plate at 03011. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
